svg.title: The gradebook, with two margins to fill
svg.desc: A grid of ten students down and five tests across, filled with scores. An empty yellow-outlined margin column on the right is labelled mean per student, an empty margin row underneath is labelled mean per test, and an empty corner box is marked as the cross-check.
svg.text: The gradebook, with two margins to fill
Ten students down, five tests across. One margin per direction.
